entries.summary: Implemented video segmentation feature: upload video, split with FFmpeg, upload segments to GitHub, display with chapter links.
entries.details: New models: VideoSegment (segment_number, duration, github_url, github_path), UploadedVideo (file, status, segment_count). Services: video_services.py (get_video_duration, split_video, upload_segment_to_github, process_video_upload). API: POST /courses/video-upload/, GET /courses/lessons/<id>/segments/. Frontend: VideoSegments.tsx component. Config: GITHUB_VIDEO_REPO_OWNER, GITHUB_VIDEO_REPO_NAME, GITHUB_VIDEO_TOKEN in settings.py and .env.
decisions: Segments uploaded to GitHub repo aura-videos
If no GitHub token, saves locally only
VideoSegment has github_url for raw file link
